name: Deflecting (Rite Publishing)
body:
Aura faint abjuration; CL 5th; Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Combat Expertise; Price +1 bonus.

DESCRIPTION

Once per round as an attack of opportunity you can deflect any ray aimed at you or anyone within your reach to another target by making a successful combat maneuver check. A failure results in you automatically being hit by the ray. The range of the spell remains unchanged.
